title: [PWgO] Preconfigured WorldGen Options
description: A mod that allows you to write world settings in configs that can later be enabled with a single button press. Useful in modpacks
body:
# **\[PWgO\] Preconfiguired WorldGen Options**

![world creation menu](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1529/907/dd12d-d14d34do-ndondd12d-2026-02-12-163753-png.png)

Mod was created specially for future **Minecraft: Below Zero modpack**, because players rarely read the entire description. This mod is intended to solve my problem: default world generation type doesn't feel snowy enough so to make it as i want player has to set world generation type to single biome with snowy taiga and some structure generation settings additionally disabled.

# How to configure it?

![configuration menu requires Configured](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1529/908/dd12d-d14d34do-ndondd12d-2026-02-12-163909-png.png)

Everything you need, you can find on [**mod GitHub page**](https://github.com/ProGaMEr110521/Preconfigured-WorldGen-Options).
